thread:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 — Observability degradation reported for customer AuroraBank (dedicated pool, tenant aurora-123). Missing traces and partial metric shards since 01:18 UTC. Alert: tenant-span-rate drop + metric-latency-increase.
Eli (oncall): I'm on it. Confirming impact window and whether logs exist for aurora-123. @Sana can you check forwarder health in the dedicated pool?
Sana: looking. dedicated-forwarder-3 shows elevated error 403 when writing to obs-collector. Rolling change to forwarder config landed ~00:55 UTC. suspect role/assume-role token expiry.
Mike R: replays of traces show the service is generating spans but collector ack count is 0 for that tenant. Logs are present in pod stdout for several requests.
Jordan: paging infra team to check IAM roles and token rotation for the dedicated forwarder role. @ops-bot can you surface the last role rotation event?
ops-bot: role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-forwarder-dedicated rotated 2023-10-09T00:50:18Z (operator: deploy-bot). No automated rotation since then.
Hera - AuroraBank CCoE: We're seeing missing traces in our APM UI and a partial metric gap on counters related to payment-authorization. Customer impact: some dashboards show 40-60% of spans missing for the last 18 minutes.
Eli (oncall): priority now P1. Short-term mitigation: enable legacy-forwarder-sink for aurora-123 to bypass token-restricted path. Sana, can you flip the sink?
Sana: started. Command:
```
kubectl -n observability set env ds/forwarder LEGACY_SINK=aurora-123 --record
```
Applying now — expecting 30–60s to warm up.
Mike R: while that rolls, we can also grant temporary assume-role to forwarder service account. Jordan, please run the following in ops jumpbox:
```
aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name redwood-forwarder-dedicated --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSPutMetricData
aws sts get-session-token --duration-seconds 3600
```
Jordan: running, will post creds ephemeral link once session token issued.
incident-bot: Notice: On-call handoff scheduled at 02:00 UTC. Eli -> Jordan (primary). Update channel for the handoff status.
Hera - AuroraBank CCoE: appreciate quick response. Is there a timeline for full trace restoration? We need to decide whether to failover traffic to hosted path.
Eli (oncall): estimate 6–10 minutes to confirm if legacy sink fully restores spans. If not, next step is controlled traffic shift to hosted model for this tenant (requires Ops + Product signoff). I'll loop you in.
Sana: legacy sink reports successful pushes — collector acks returning. I'm seeing spans reappear for samples in the tail. metrics ingestion lag decreasing.
Mike R: validating with sample trace ids — three of five test traces now visible in APM. Dashboard gap shrinking. Recording mitigation steps in incident tracker.
Jordan: temporary IAM changes applied and session generated. Forwarder auth error 403 cleared. I'll roll a short-lived policy fix and open a PR to make rotation observable.
Hera - AuroraBank CCoE: confirmed traces returning in our dashboards. We'll monitor for 30 mins and report if anything odd.
Eli (oncall): Post-incident actions: 1) revert legacy-sink toggle once stable 2) add rotation alert for forwarder role 3) verify per-tenant metric shard assignment didn't get rebalanced mid-rolling deploy. Assigning owners: Sana -> sink toggle & revert, Jordan -> role rotation alert + PR, Mike -> audit metrics for missing samples and impact window.
incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved to mitigation state at 02:07 UTC — data flowing. Monitoring for 30m. Pager cleared for escalation.
Hera - AuroraBank CCoE: thanks all. We'll keep watching and will reach out if anomalies persist.
Eli (oncall): closing thread update here. Will post the incident recap to #postmortems when we have timeline and root cause.
